description:
The '''Ranger''', formerly known as the '''Outlaw''', is an advanced cliff [[Towers|tower]] with long range that can be purchased in the store for {{Coins|12,000}}.

The '''Ranger''' deals high damage with very long range but has a slow firerate. As a cliff tower, it can detect [[Flying]] enemies, but cannot detect hidden enemies at any level. The '''Ranger''' can also damage lead enemies at Level 2+. Additionally, it is immune to all stuns by default. At Level 2, it gains the ability to give towers a 10% [[Range Buff]] within its inner radius at the start of every wave for 20 seconds. At Level 4, it also deals splash damage through its ''Explosive Impact''.

The '''Ranger''' deals extremely high damage at higher levels, but is expensive to upgrade to these levels. Due to these reasons, it is considered a mid-to-late game tower and is most effective for harder gamemodes.

The '''Ranger''' has a placement limit of eight per player.
